scope: Two sculpture proportions corrected at the user's request: JIE LAN now has a closed opaque equal-axis plant-fibre sphere beneath the botanical collage, rather than a hollow scaffold. interaction: Direct start and browsable index; optional session-only resume; desktop sticky chapters and contact-sheet directory; mobile bottom actions and directory sheet; explicit still/live modes; secondary 3D controls; filmstrip, image status, desktop arrows and keyboard, native dialog focus and same-URL Back-to-close.
mobilePresentation: Touch devices up to 900 CSS pixels still enter through high-resolution photographs, with explicit opt-in to the original 3D scenes. modelLimitations: GLB files contain the existing static geometry/material snapshots, not webpage lighting, postprocessing, rain animation, audio or garden interaction.
referenceUse: Interaction/design references only. No third-party application code, images, fonts or branding copied.
